title: Windows devices are in no update ring

report.title: {Items.Count} Windows {Plural(Items.Count, 'device is', 'devices are')} not covered by an update ring

messages.businessImpact: These machines receive updates on Windows defaults, so deferrals and deadlines the organisation set do not apply to them at all.
remediation: Widen the broad ring's assignment to all Windows devices and use exclusions for the exceptions.
Check whether the devices are simply missing from the group the rings target.
